bridge.title: Arena Local Bridge
bridge.subtitle: Connects Automatic workers to your own Arena accounts through the Arena Local Bridge program running on your computer.
bridge.warningBody: Arena Local Bridge is not an official Arena API. It drives Arena’s website with the accounts signed in to it, and Arena’s terms may prohibit automated use. Nothing is sent to Arena until a Super Admin acknowledges the terms for that bridge. The platform never bypasses sign-in, CAPTCHA, rate limits or quotas.
bridge.warningHuman: You do not need a bridge: in Human-Assisted mode a person pastes each task into Arena and submits the answer here.

how.1: On your Windows computer, start Arena Local Bridge (ArenaLocalBridge.exe from its ZIP). Its own window opens at http://127.0.0.1:20140.
how.2: In the bridge’s window, sign in each of your Arena accounts and wait until it is shown as usable.
how.3: Make sure the bridge lists at least one session (conversation) for each account. Each worker will use one session.
how.4: Copy the bridge’s key (ARENA_AGENT_BRIDGE_KEY) from the bridge’s window or from its .env file.
how.5: Here, choose “Add bridge”, enter the address and the key, then “Test connection”. Every step should pass.
how.6: Read Arena’s terms and acknowledge them for this bridge. Until then nothing is sent to Arena.
how.7: On “Manager & workers”, set a worker to Automatic and choose its session. The others can stay Human-Assisted.
